0.0: Hey, aren't you the one that made the #t4032332# the other day? How's the wolf pup growing? Hopefully that formula worked on the little pup... Anyway, what brought you here this time?\n#b#L0#(You show him Ryko and then the two of you discuss Ryko's health.)#l\n#k
0.1: Ahh, so the name is #t1902015#? So, #t1902015# is already on the verge of puberty. This time, I'll have to prepare a #bformula for adolescent wolves#k. In puberty, wolves require even more nutrients to keep them healthy.

yes.0: If you can just bring me the ingredients, I'll be able to make a nutritious meal for the adolescent wolves again! I need #b100 #t4000182#s#k, #b100 #t4000183#s#k, #b100 #t4000184#s#k, and 1 #b#t4032333##k, which is sold by #p2060005#. Yeah, I suppose that's quite a bit... Well... Good luck!

no.0: I once raised a husky that I didn't really take very good care of while it was going through its adolescent stages. And it went crazy, destroying my sled while eating everything in sight. Very tough to handle... I bet you your wolf will act like that, too, if you don't take proper care of it. Please reconsider.

1.0: Wow, you managed to bring all the ingredients? Please wait for a bit. I'll make the formula for you right now!
1.1: Here's the formula for adolescent wolves! Give it to #t1902015# right now.

yes.0: Ohh, based on how satisfied #t1902015# looked, it must taste pretty good. Please continue taking care of this adorable wolf pup.
